Exam Date & Time: 08-May-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - APRIL / MAY 2025  
  SUBJECT: CHM 1071/CHM_1071 - ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY  
  ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY [CHM 1071-CHM]  
Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Define single electrode potential. What is Eo Ni2+/Ni at 298 K, if the emf of Zn(s) ǀ  
  Zn2+ (1 M) ǁ Ni2+ (1.5 M) ǀ Ni(s) is 0.51 V and the emf of Zn(s) ǀ Zn2+(1 M) ǁ SCE is   (4)  
  $$1.002 V. (ESCE=0.2422 V).$$  
  
1B)          i) List any two key functions of separator in batteries.  
  ii) Discuss the construction, charging and discharging reactions of Lithium-ion         (4)  
  battery.  
  
1C)          Justify: HCl is added to copper chloride electrolyte during electroplating of copper.  
  Write any two differences between concentration and kinetic polarization.               (2)  
  
2A)          i) Explain the conductometric titration of strong acid versus weak base with relevant  
  graphical illustration.  
  ii) A colored solution has an absorbance of 0.75 when measured in a 1 cm cuvette.     (4)  
  The wavelength used is 500 nm. The molar absorptivity is 20,000 L mol -1 cm-1.  
  Calculate the concentration of the solution.  
  
2B)          i) How is total hardness of water determined by EDTA method?  
  ii) Write any two disadvantages of sludge formation. Mention any two preventive         (4)  
  methods.  
  
2C)          Name the chemical compounds used in lime soda process. Mention any two  
  advantages of this process.                                                             (2)  
  
3A)          i) Explain the anodic protection method of preventing corrosion.  
  ii) With suitable reactions explain the electrochemical theory of rusting of iron.      (4)  
  
3B)          i) Explain the role of inhibitors in preventing hydrogen evolution and oxygen  
  absorption type of reactions.                                                           (4)  
  ii) Write two preventive measures each to avoid galvanic and stress corrosion.  
  
3C)          i) Give reason: Corrosion of magnesium is faster than zinc when in contact with iron  
  in a medium.                                                                         (2)  
  ii) Differentiate galvanizing from tinning.  
  
4A)          i) Differentiate between the following (Any two points each)  
  a) Thermotropic and lyotropic liquid crystal.  
  b) Top down method and bottom - up approach.                                            (4)  
  ii) Explain the chemical vapour deposition process of thin film fabrication.  
  (2+2 = 4 marks)

4B)             The polymer sample has the following composition.  
  
  
  i) If the number average molecular weight of the sample is 20000. Calculate the      (4)  
  weight average molecular weight and polydispersity index of the polymer sample.  
  ii) Explain the effect of plasticizer on glass transition temperature of polymer.  
  (3+1 = 4 marks)  
  
4C)             i) Why polyvinyl chloride (PVC) has higher strength than Polyethylene?  
  ii) Write the properties of aramid - fibre reinforced composite materials.           (2)  
  
5A)             i) Define decomposition potential of an electrolyte.  
  ii) The EMF of the cell, Zn I ZnCl2 II AgCl I Ag at 303K is 1.803 V. If the  
  temperature coefficient of EMF is -2.3 X 10-3 V.K-1, calculate ∆G, ∆H and ∆S for     (4)  
  the reaction at 303K.  
  (1+3 = 4 marks)  
  
5B)             i) Give reasons for the following:  
  a) Ionic compounds are soluble in polar solvents.  
  b) HF has higher boiling point than HCl.  
  ii) Explain the classification polymers based on method of formation and response to (4)  
  heat.  
  (2+2 = 4 marks)  
  
5C)             Explain the role of anodic inhibitor in corrosion control.  
  (2)  
  
  
-----End-----
